label: preparing
what: A covert plan or coordination about a bridge or port change, discussed at the bakery; Baker has also arranged eighty contracted loaves delivered to the hall, though the records do not establish that the bread delivery is part of the plan. Freight relayed details and helped coordinate the hall delivery/inspection logistics. The secretary knows about the hall inspection and bread delivery, but there is no evidence she knowingly supports the bridge/port plan; the builder's lighting inspection appears separate.
